newsitem.title: HUNGARY: GAZPROM'S HUNGARY BANK AEB PLANS TO BOOST SOURCES.
newsitem.headline: GAZPROM'S HUNGARY BANK AEB PLANS TO BOOST SOURCES.

text.p: Hungary's Altalanos Ertekforgalmi Bank Rt (AEB), a member of Russia's Gazprom group, said on Thursday it had raised interest rates on forex deposits in order to boost its foreign currency sources.

"The bank earlier offered low interest but (with the rises) has stepped into the first line of the domestic banking market, concerning foreign currency deposit interest rates," AEB said in a statement.

AEB said that from Novenber 4 it had raised interest paid on one-year dollar deposits larger than $3000 by about 10 percent -- to 5.125 percent from 4.5625 percent -- while rates on other foreign currency deposits had increased by between three and 17 percent, AEB said.
Gazprom earlier this week signed an agreement with three Hungarian banks, including AEB, as lead managers for the syndication of a $160 millign loan for which Gazprom would tap the Hungarian market.
The lead managers undertook to lend $80 million of the syndicated loan.
This is the first substantial loan which the gas giant Gazprom has taken up from central and east European banks.
Gazprombank, the banking arm of Gazprom which owns AEB, said earlier AEB would finance Gazprom projects, including gas supplies to Hungary and other countries in the region.
